request.subject: UNIT:CATAPULT

layers.text: Redraw it as a high-medieval siege engine: the pennant becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow stripe; the cloth on the frame deep crimson with a gold-yellow trim; the crew man's hood deep crimson with a gold-yellow trim; the wood a warm oak brown with steel bands. Keep the catapult, wheels, bucket and stone, the crew man, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the wheels.
